title: About Amber
description: Baltic amber holds many secrets. Formed by nature, this fossilised resin evokes positive energy, serves as a good luck charm, and recalls seaside memories. Often called the Gold of the Baltic and the Living Stone, it captivates with its timeless allure.

People have named and described over 100 colour varieties of Baltic amber!, with yellow being the most common, symbolizing the sun.
